camel_example: aliyun esa TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 1 --Tag.1.Key env --Tag.1.Value value --ResourceType site --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Adds one or more tags to resources
kebab_example: aliyun esa tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id 1 --tag Value=value Key=env --resource-type site --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. Valid values:

China site (aliyun.com): cn-hangzhou
International site (alibabacloud.com): ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID，取值范围如下：

中国站：cn-hangzhou
国际站：ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. Enter a website ID or DNS record ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。请输入站点ID或者DNS记录ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to add to the resource. You can enter up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。最多可输入20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

Site: site
DNS records: record
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值范围如下：

站点：site
DNS记录：record
parameters.name: resource_type
